name: Raguel
title: Sara's father in the Book of Tobit
summary: Raguel was a relative of Tobit who lived in Ecbatana in Media. He was the father of Sara, who married Tobias after an evil spirit had killed her seven previous husbands.

keyEvents.title: Gives Sara to Tobias
keyEvents.description: Raguel gave his daughter Sara to Tobias in marriage and celebrated the wedding for fourteen days.
